metadata.title: How to make Chili oil
metadata.description:
The simple chili oil is an essential condiment in many homes, This is mainly made and used by Tibetan and Bhutanese people. In this video I show you how to make chili oil. 

Ingredients:

Cooking oil - 2 cups  make sure the oil is of neutral taste, strong tasting oil like mustard oil will alter the taste. 

Chili flake - 1/3 cup
Chili Powder - 1/3 cup
White Sesame seeds - 2 tbsp
Black Vinegar - 1 tbsp
star Anise - 3 nos
Cinnamon - 2 inch piece
Aniseed - 1 tbsp
Sichuan pepper - 2 tbsp
Bay leaf  - 1
Ginger - 2 inch piece
Onion - medium 1 no
Spring onion - as required
Coriander leaves - as required
sugar - 1 tsp
Salt to taste
 
Lets Connect!

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/eatyourkappa/
